svg.text: Highlighted: no other configuration in this run is both cheaper and scored higher. 9 of 13 are, including one of the maintainer's own.
100 questions, 2026-08-06. Answer key established on the day of the run by 8 independent systems, one vote per provider.
At n=100 the correct column carries about plus or minus 10 points. The cost column does not.
serpdive-krill costs zero at the door on every plan of its vendor. That is its list price, not a promotion.
